content.text: Summary

Every table in the application gets an inline search control that lets users type to narrow records instantly, working additively with filters. This replaces the old behavior where the global search silently filtered page content, giving users a dedicated, predictable search scoped strictly to the table they're looking at.
Context
The search control lives in the page toolbar alongside the filter toggle and primary CTA
Search is delivered through the shared table component — it applies to every table in the app (list pages, detail page tables, dialog tables — 42 surfaces total)
The query is session-scoped: it survives navigation within the tab but does not persist server-side or sync across devices
Search and filters are additive (AND) but independently cleared
Requirements
A Search control is displayed in the page toolbar, positioned before icon-only actions and the primary CTA — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R1
Default state: low-emphasis text button with magnifier icon and "Search" label — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R2
On hover: grey/100 background fill — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R3
On click: expands in place into a 180px text input, growing leftward from its anchor — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R4
Expanded empty state: magnifier icon, text caret, "Type to search" placeholder — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R5
With text entered: grey/900 text, X-circle clear icon appears — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R6
Query applies as the user types, debounced at 300ms (Inventory: 350ms). No apply button or Enter required — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R7
Long queries: standard text input behavior with horizontal scroll — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R8
Search is scoped strictly to the current table — never returns results from another table, page, or module — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R9
Search and filters are additive (AND) — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R10
On pages with tabs, search applies within the active tab only — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R11
Results replace the table contents in place; no separate results view — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R12
X-circle clears the query and restores the filtered-but-unsearched state; "Clear filters" does not clear search and vice versa — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R13
Query retained for the browser tab session; survives sorting, pagination, and navigation — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R14
Blur with empty field collapses to default state; blur with query keeps field expanded — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R15
Mobile: same inline expansion, no modal or separate screen — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R16
Mobile: expanded field fills remaining action row width (162px on WO); all toolbar actions stay visible — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R17
Mobile: primary CTA uses natural hug width (144px) instead of stretching — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R18
Mobile: pages with 2+ icon-only actions collapse them into a "more" kebab — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R19
Every table in the app carries a search control via the shared table component — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R22
Each table searches the fields its existing search endpoint already covers — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R23
On pages with tabs, query scoping matches that page's filter scoping (WO tabs share one query; Reports/Parts tabs keep separate queries) — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R24
Query stored in browser tab session only, never server-side; does not sync across devices; two tabs keep independent queries — (
PRD: Story 13, S13-R25
Out of Scope
Hover-on-expanded, disabled, and loading states
Per-table search field documentation (pending from engineering, S13-R23)
Acceptance Criteria
Given I'm on Work Orders, when I click the Search button, then it expands into a 180px text input
Given I type "Smith", then the table narrows to matching records after 300ms debounce
Given I have filters active and type a query, then the query narrows within the filtered set
Given I click X-circle, then the query clears and the table returns to filtered-only state
Given I clear filters, then the search query remains active — filters and search are independent
Given I'm on mobile, when I tap Search, then the field expands inline and the keyboard appears
Given Inventory page, then the debounce is 350ms instead of 300ms
Given I navigate away and return (same tab), then my search query is restored
Given the tab session ends, then the query is not restored on next visit
Given I collapse the filter bar while searching, then the query continues to apply
UI/UX
Figma — Page Search Component
